$schema: AZAR Design System — machine-readable tokens. Authoritative numeric source; see /docs/ui/design-system.md for rationale and usage rules. Do not edit values here without updating design-system.md to match.

meta.name: AZAR Design System
meta.foundation: Material Design 3 structure (https://m3.material.io/), custom "Professional Navy" palette/shape/elevation (supersedes v2.0.0-v2.8.6's warm/cool "Minimal Luxury" neutral family)
meta.changeLog: v2.9.0: full re-theme per explicit user direction — the prior 'Minimal Luxury' neutral-black-ink + off-white-gray palette read as too plain/generic for a professional CRM a broker uses in front of clients; also flagged that prior design-doc governance (this file + design-system.md) was making legitimate palette/spacing change requests harder than they needed to be, not easier. This pass makes the following base-token changes; every component consuming theme.colors.*/theme.layout.*/theme.typographyRtl automatically inherits them (no per-screen changes needed, confirmed by the app's existing token-only palette-swap history at v2.0.0/v2.2.0). (1) Primary: charcoal-black #1E1E20 -> a muted, low-formality navy #2E3B52 (chosen from 3 candidate navy swatches by explicit user pick), used for primary buttons/high-emphasis text/active nav state; onPrimary stays white (#FFFFFF, contrast ratio ~9.4:1, comfortably AA/AAA) since text-on-solid-color legibility is a correctness requirement independent of the calmer/lower-contrast *surface* aesthetic requested. New primaryContainer is a barely-tinted navy-gray (#DCE3EC) instead of the old primaryContainer being a *darker* shade of primary (#2C2C2F) - previously primaryContainer read as another near-black tone; now it reads as a distinct, lighter tonal surface, matching how every other *Container role in this palette already behaves. (2) Neutrals: cool off-white-gray #F6F6F7 -> a slightly cooler, slightly lighter, lower-contrast #F4F5F7 background/surface (explicit user pick between two gray candidates); the full surfaceContainerLowest->Highest ladder and onSurface/onSurfaceVariant/outline/outlineVariant steps were recomputed as smaller, tighter jumps around that new base so adjacent tiers read as closer in value ('low contrast' as explicitly requested) rather than the old wider steps; onSurface changed from near-black #1E1E20 to a soft navy-charcoal #2A3242 so body text reads as part of the same navy family as primary instead of a separate pure-neutral ink. (3) Secondary (bronze #8A6D3B)/tertiary (emerald #2F4F3E) and all semantic colors (error/success/warning/info) are UNCHANGED - the user's ask was specifically about the primary/neutral family reading as more professional and lower-contrast, not about replacing the brand accents or functional-signal colors, and semantic colors intentionally stay close to their conventional hues regardless of theme (§1). (4) Spacing: component.card.paddingDetail 32->24 and paddingListItem 20->16, layout.sectionSpacing 32->24 and layout.screenPaddingBottom 32->24 - the prior 'minimal luxury' padding was tuned for an airy boutique feel; a professional CRM used all day benefits from a denser, business-tool rhythm instead, per explicit user direction to reduce the 'simple/plain' read. screenPaddingX/componentSpacing/textToElementSpacing and the raw space0-16 scale are unchanged - those were never the reported problem. (5) Typography: kept Vazirmatn as the only bundled/shipped Persian typeface per explicit user direction (swapping fonts would require sourcing and bundling new .ttf assets, not available in this pass) - reviewed and tightened the RTL line-height column instead, which was a flat +26-34% over the LTR scale across every token (a v2.0.0 'more generous/airy luxury' choice); each RTL line-height is now recomputed closer to (but still safely above, given Vazirmatn's real diacritic/vertical-metric needs) its LTR counterpart, trimming excess vertical whitespace per row without harming Persian legibility. Font sizes/weights are unchanged. (6) Elevation: shadowColor updated from the old ink #1E1E20 to the new navy primary #2E3B52 so card shadows read as part of the new palette family instead of a leftover neutral-black tint; shadow opacity/blur/offset values themselves are unchanged. No radius/motion/icon/grid/component-contract values outside the two spacing tokens above changed in this pass. v2.8.6: large batch per explicit user direction, spanning auth, forms, and several screens. (1) RTL: codified 'Persian text starts from the right edge, everywhere' as a mandatory rule in design-system.md §10, backed by an app-wide audit confirming theme.typography() is the sole, unconditional enforcement point (zero hardcoded textAlign:'left' exceptions in src/). (2) Auth: OtpVerificationScreen gained a 2-minute resend cooldown (prevents back-to-back code requests) and, after a successful verify, now tries login() first and only falls through to the ReferralCode/register screen on a genuine 'no account for this number' result — an already-registered phone is never asked for a referral code again. AuthScreenContainer's default layout changed from full vertical centering to two flex-ratio spacers (1:2) anchoring content around the screen's upper third, so it stays visible above the keyboard once open. (3) Forms: PropertyForm and ApplicantForm's fields regrouped into FormRow 2-column pairs per explicit layout spec (title/propertyType, transactionType/city, area/rooms for properties; name/phone, transactionType/propertyType, city/rooms for applicants); min/max budget and area fields gained helper text explaining they drive automatic match suggestions (matchingService), since their purpose wasn't previously stated anywhere in the UI. Added 'تهاتر' (barter) as a fourth transaction-type option on both the property and applicant sides, with a same-to-same compatibility entry in matchingService's TRANSACTION_COMPATIBILITY map. (4) New rent/mortgage fields: deposit_amount, rent_amount, is_convertible added to both properties and applicants (migration 0014) — shown conditionally when the transaction type contains رهن/اجاره, with a new shared Checkbox component for the convertibility flag and a shared rentStatus.ts util that derives 'رهن کامل' when rent is explicitly 0 with a real deposit, or 'فقط اجاره' when deposit is explicitly 0 with real rent. (5) Lists: PropertyListScreen and ApplicantListScreen gained pull-to-refresh (RefreshControl) and a new shared FloatingActionButton pinned bottom-corner so a file can be added even when the list already has rows, not only from the empty state. PropertyListItem's price/area/rooms/match-count grid (2-3 rows) condensed into a single inline meta line — shorter cards, more fit on screen, matching the app's search-first focus. (6) Settings: the name field is now a label with a small gray 'ویرایش' word that toggles inline edit mode, instead of an always-editable input; session status now reads the real local session record (creation time) instead of a hardcoded 'فعال' string; logout moved behind a new top-left 3-dot menu (new 'moreVertical' icon), freeing the screen of its standalone logout button; added a full account-deletion flow (new server endpoint POST /auth/delete-account, requiring the same fresh-OTP-verified state as register/login) surfaced through a new shared OtpPromptDialog component. PasswordPromptDialog and the new OtpPromptDialog both gained explicit KeyboardAvoidingView handling — Modal renders outside the normal view hierarchy so AndroidManifest's adjustResize doesn't reach it, and card maxHeight:90% keeps the dialog from climbing off the top edge on a short screen with a tall keyboard. (7) Forms: new shared useUnsavedChangesGuard hook (navigation's beforeRemove event, not just BackHandler, so it also catches header-back and swipe-back) prompts before discarding an in-progress create or edit on Property/Applicant screens. (8) Dashboard: StatCard's icon badge is now a soft two-color gradient (same technique as Avatar.tsx) instead of a flat tonal fill, and the card uses a soft level1 shadow instead of a bare hairline border — still deliberately quieter than the Needs Attention section below it (design-system.md §14 point 2), just less flat. No color/spacing/radius base token values changed this pass — every visual change reuses existing palette entries. v2.8.5: real-device screenshot confirmed the v2.8.4 alignSelf inversion fix landed correctly. (1) Completed the app-wide flex:1-on-Text audit (design-system.md §10's v2.8.3 note) per explicit direction to sweep every screen — found and fixed 2 more overlooked instances, ApplicantDetailScreen.tsx and PropertyDetailScreen.tsx's titleRow title beside its StatusBadge, both changed to flexShrink:1 alone (matching ContractDetailScreen.tsx's already-fixed pattern); a repeat script search now returns zero remaining matches. (2) Dashboard header: removed the referral-code subtitle (now Settings-only, avoids showing the same fact twice) and replaced the static 'خوش آمدید' greeting with a time-of-day greeting (صبح/عصر/شب بخیر) plus the user's own name when set, via new getTimeBasedGreeting() util and useDisplayName() hook (new 'display_name' key in application_settings, editable via a new name field at the top of the Settings card). (3) Auth screens: AuthScreenContainer's default justifyContent changed from flex-start to center — PhoneEntry/OtpVerification/ReferralCode content was pinned to the top of an otherwise-empty screen; WelcomeScreen (explicit justify="space-between") is unaffected. (4) Dashboard KPI cards: statCardGrid.gap set to an explicit literal 10px per direct user request (previous space-1/4px read as too cramped), columnBasisPercent nudged 48%→47% to make room, StatCard's internal padding bumped back from space-2 to space-3 so the cards read less small. (5) Avatar: fallback initials now render over a soft diagonal SVG gradient (secondary bronze → primary ink, react-native-svg) instead of a flat primaryContainer fill — same public API, used on the Dashboard header. No color/type/spacing base token values changed beyond statCardGrid.gap/columnBasisPercent and StatCard padding noted above. v2.8.4: (1) icon.* scale bumped one step up (16/18/24/32/48 -> 18/20/26/34/52) per explicit feedback that icons read too small. (2) Dates: formatDate/formatDateTime now request the Jalali calendar explicitly via the 'fa-IR-u-ca-persian' locale instead of bare 'fa-IR' - confirmed on-device that 'fa-IR' alone was resolving to the Gregorian calendar (Persian digit glyphs, but Gregorian year/month/day) on this app's Hermes/ICU build, even though Node's full-ICU environment (and therefore this repo's Jest tests) resolves 'fa-IR' to Jalali correctly either way - the discrepancy only reproduces on-device. dashboardDataService.ts's duplicate local formatDate/formatDateTime were deleted in favor of importing the shared util, so the fix (and any future one) applies everywhere at once. (3) Dashboard stats/recent-activity went stale after creating a property or applicant from the Dashboard's own quick actions, because useDashboardData only fetched on mount and the Dashboard (a bottom-tab screen) stays mounted across tab switches - switched to useFocusEffect so it refetches every time the tab regains focus. (4) alignSelf inversion (see design-system.md §10's v2.8.4 note) - real device screenshot of PropertyDetailScreen (untouched since v2.3.0) showed every DetailRow label/value still flush-left despite already carrying the documented alignSelf ternary; root-caused to that ternary's 'flex-end' choice only ever having worked by coincidence, back when native RTL (fixed for real in v2.8.0) was never actually active. Flipped all ~43 occurrences of theme.isRTL ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start' to theme.isRTL ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end' app-wide. This could not be verified against a real Yoga layout pass and needs next-screenshot confirmation. No color/type/spacing base values changed beyond the icon scale noted above. v2.8.3: real device screenshot after v2.8.1 (icons confirmed fixed, native RTL mirroring finally active per v2.8.0) showed the Dashboard header and its quick-actions/needs-attention rows with the label text hugging the wrong edge, a large empty gap to the icon it belongs next to. Root cause (design-system.md §10, a second distinct bug class alongside the alignSelf one): `flex: 1` set directly on the `<Text>` itself (QuickActions.tsx, NeedsAttentionList.tsx, DashboardScreen.tsx's header/secondaryActionLabel, also found and fixed in ContractDetailScreen.tsx and ReminderAttentionHeader.tsx) stretched the text's own box across the row's remaining width, and the stretched box's content did not reliably right-align on-device despite an explicit textAlign. Fixed structurally: icon+label now group in their own flexShrink row (never flex:1) so they stay adjacent regardless of which edge justifyContent:'space-between' sends the group to on the outer row. No color/type/spacing token values changed. v2.8.2: new shared PasswordPromptDialog component (same 'glass' dialog shell as ConfirmDialog, §7.9, with a password TextInput instead of a yes/no choice) for the new on-device backup feature — Settings screen gained a 'پشتیبان‌گیری' section that builds a password-encrypted snapshot of the entire local database (BackupService.createBackupFile, reusing the already-built backupFile.ts AES-256-GCM+Argon2id encryption) and hands it to the OS share sheet. New dependency: react-native-fs, used only to write the backup file into the app's private cache directory (no storage permission needed). No color/type/spacing token values changed. v2.8.1: Dashboard KPI grid tightened again (statCardGrid.gap space2→space1, columnBasisPercent 47%→48%) — still read as too much air after the v2.7.2 pass. Settings screen: the referral code no longer appears twice — the standalone code+copy row above the QR code was removed, the copy button moved to sit beside the code printed under the QR code (design-system.md's 'one representation per fact' principle); the session-status label and value are now a single row (label right, dot+value left in RTL) instead of stacked, matching how every other status-style row in the app reads. MoneyInput: removed the 'برای تکمیل سریع رقم، واحد را انتخاب کنید' caption above the zero-count chips — the chips' own labels (000,000 / 000,000,000) already say what they do, per v2.6.0's original self-explanatory-chip rationale; the caption was redundant. Auth: PhoneEntryScreen was already backed by a canonicalizeIranPhoneNumber() util that accepts local 09... numbers, but (a) its placeholder showed +989121234567, visually implying that prefix was required, and (b) the number wasn't actually being canonicalized before being sent to sendOtp()/register() — MockAuthApiClient's own PHONE_NUMBER_PATTERN requires a leading +/1-9 digit, so a locally-typed 0-prefixed number was silently rejected. Fixed by canonicalizing at the screen boundary (before every sendOtp/verifyOtp/register call) and changing the placeholder to 09121234567. v2.8.0: two real root-cause fixes, both found by reading the failing dependency's own source instead of guessing again. (1) Icons: replaced the hand-drawn View/border icon set (design-system.md §6), which kept shipping visibly wrong glyphs across several fix rounds, with react-native-vector-icons' Ionicons font — a mature, professionally drawn set; android/app/build.gradle links only Ionicons.ttf. Every IconName maps 1:1 to an Ionicons glyph name in Icon.tsx; directional glyphs (chevron, chevronDouble) still flip by isRTL. (2) RTL: v2.7.1's fix (calling react-native-restart's restart() after flipping I18nManager.forceRTL) never actually worked — that library's Android Restart() only calls recreateReactContextInBackground(), which reloads the JS bundle inside the *same* Activity/ReactRootView, so the layout-direction flag is never re-read (confirmed by reading node_modules/react-native-restart's source: it imports ProcessPhoenix, which would do a real process restart, but never calls it). Replaced with a small custom native module, AzarRestart.recreateActivity() (android/app/src/main/java/com/azarapp/AzarRestartModule.kt), that calls the real Activity.recreate() — which does create a fresh ReactRootView and picks up the persisted RTL flag. react-native-restart removed as a dependency. No color/type/spacing token values changed in this pass — the reported defects (RTL, icons) were both mechanism bugs, not palette/typography choices, so the existing 'Minimal Luxury' visual direction (v2.0.0-v2.7.2) is kept rather than churned without evidence of what's actually wrong with it. v2.7.2: Dashboard KPI grid tightened (statCardGrid.gap space3→space2, StatCard internal padding space3→space2, columnBasisPercent 46%→47%) so the 4 cards sit at a spacing proportional to the rest of the screen instead of visibly oversized gaps. Wording: every user-facing occurrence of 'پرونده' (dossier/case) replaced with 'فایل' (file) — bottom-tab label, empty states, form labels, dialogs, dashboard stat label/activity text — per explicit user direction that 'فایل' is the correct term for this app's domain. Bottom tab bar redesigned: Android's default full-segment gray background/ripple on tab press removed (new TabBarButton with a subtle press-scale instead of android_ripple) and tabBarActiveBackgroundColor's whole-segment fill replaced with a Material-3-style active-indicator pill drawn only behind the icon. Settings screen consolidated from 3 separate cards (phone/referral/session) into one sectioned card with hairline dividers, matching the pattern already established on ContractDetailScreen. New: referral-code QR generation (react-native-qrcode-svg/react-native-svg) shown on the Settings screen below the referral code text, and a QR/barcode scan flow on ReferralCodeScreen (new shared QrCodeScanner component using react-native-camera-kit, new 'scan' icon) that auto-fills the referral code field from a scanned code — validation against the database is unchanged, still happens in the existing register() call. Adds 3 new native dependencies (react-native-svg, react-native-qrcode-svg, react-native-camera-kit) plus Android CAMERA permission. v2.7.1: fixed the real remaining RTL root cause (design-system.md §10) — I18nManager.forceRTL() only persists the flag for the *next* app launch, so the first session after every fresh install or app update still rendered LTR-mirrored rows until the user manually force-closed and reopened once. index.js now auto-restarts (react-native-restart) the moment the flag is first flipped, so the correct RTL state applies within the same install/update, no user action needed. No UI/token changes. v2.7.0: new SelectionListItem component (design-system.md §17.8) for pick-one-of-many record steps (currently the Matching Workspace's property/applicant picker) — colored circular icon badge (AZAR's own bronze/emerald accents, not the generic blue from the reference screenshot that prompted it) + bold title + quiet subtitle + trailing chevron/check, lighter than the full PropertyListItem/ApplicantListItem cards. Also: OTP dev code changed to 555555, and OtpInput's backspace/delete behavior fixed to work from any box (was previously only reliable from the last box). No color/type/spacing base values changed. v2.6.0: Phase 2 CRM workflow redesign (Matching/Deal/Reminder/Contract, design-system.md §17) — Matching Workspace with honest (non-fabricated) match scoring via a new MatchingResult component; Deal Pipeline compacted from 9 real stages to 4 visual groups + 2 terminals via PipelineIndicator; Deal/Contract/Reminder detail screens gained a Next Action block and ContextHeader for cross-entity orientation; the Activity timeline pattern (previously Dashboard-only) was relocated to a shared ActivityTimeline component reused by Property/Applicant/Deal/Contract instead of being reimplemented per entity. No new large-amount money-input pattern was added — the existing MoneyInput scale chips already cover it. No schema/status-value changes. v2.5.0: Professional CRM redesign — 8 design principles (design-system.md §0.2) formalized; new Status System (§6.5) with a 5-tone StatusBadge component reusing existing color roles (no new hex), plus real derived status for properties/applicants (reads existing Deal/Reminder data, no schema change); Dashboard restructured into a command-center section order with a new 'Needs Attention' section ranked above Primary Actions (§14); component tokens gained a `statusBadge` entry. No color/type/spacing base values changed — this is architecture + composition, not a palette change. v2.4.0: the v2.3.0 alignSelf fix for the RTL Text-box-shrink bug (design-system.md §10) was only applied to the ~10 files visible in one screenshot review, not app-wide — the bug was still reported after v2.3.0 shipped because dozens of other standalone Text nodes (list screens, empty/error states, dialogs, shared components) had the identical defect and were never audited. v2.4.0 fixes it exhaustively across every file in src/ that renders a standalone block-level Text inside a column container, and hardens §10's wording to state explicitly that the rule is app-wide and must be checked file-by-file, not screen-by-screen. No color/type/shape/spacing values changed. v2.3.0: fixed a real shipped bug — every short field-label Text (design-system.md §10's new mandatory alignSelf rule) was rendering flush-left despite textAlign:'right', because a short Text in a column flex container does not reliably stretch to full width; documented the fix as a mandatory pattern. Also: removed prescriptive per-screen icon-glyph mapping from §6 (icon choice now governed by rules, not a docs catalogue); added §16 Navigation Architecture (one tab owns each screen, no more full-stack duplication across all 5 tabs); §7.2.1/§7.2.2 codify the money-chip (million/billion only, digit-group labels) and search-includes-price rules. v2.2.0: neutral-palette swap — warm ivory/near-black-warm-ink neutrals (background #FAF8F5, primary #1C1B19) replaced with a cool off-white-gray + charcoal-black neutral scale (background #F6F6F7, primary #1E1E20) per explicit user direction. Only the ink/surface neutral family changed; the two brand accents (secondary bronze #8A6D3B, tertiary emerald #2F4F3E) and all semantic colors (error/success/warning/info) are unchanged. v2.1.0: layout-hardening pass — v2.0.0 defined color/type/shape but left page layout, RTL overflow safety, and phone-width responsive behavior as unwritten convention, which let the Dashboard KPI grid ship with a minWidth-driven flex-wrap that silently collapses to 1 column (huge near-empty cards) on any device <=390px wide. Adds named `layout` tokens (screen padding, section/component spacing), a `statCardGrid` component contract (fixed-column, not minWidth-threshold), an `emptyStateCompact` variant, and phone breakpoints (320-430) alongside the existing tablet/desktop `grid` block. No color/type/shape/radius/elevation values changed. v2.0.0: full visual reset — "Minimal Luxury" direction (warm-neutral ivory/ink surfaces + two restrained accents replacing the old cool-gray/near-black Material-generated palette), rounder shape scale, softer/larger-blur elevation, more generous card padding and RTL line-heights. Every token key name is unchanged from v1.1.0 so the change is a value swap, not a schema change. v1.1.0: FINAL UI correction pass before Phase 4 — distinct `warning` token separated from `error`; `iconButton` corrected from a 40px visual size with a merely 'recommended' 48dp hit area to a mandatory 48dp hit area around an unenlarged icon; `color.dark` remains explicitly deferred (unchanged, not populated).

dark.$status: NOT DEFINED — flagged gap, see design-system.md §11. No dark palette has been designed. Do not populate this object with guessed values; a dedicated dark-palette design pass is required first.

notes.success: A distinct deep-emerald hue, deliberately separate from `tertiary` even though both are green-family — `success` is a semantic/functional signal (operation succeeded, positive money state) while `tertiary` is a brand accent; keeping them independently editable matters more than sharing one value would save.
notes.warning: Use `warning`/`warning-container` for non-fatal caution states — contract approaching expiration, reminder-related caution, restore-flow warnings before the destructive commit step. Reserve `error`/`error-container` strictly for genuine failures — failed operations, invalid input, corrupted data, authentication failure, the destructive commit action itself. See design-system.md §1.
notes.info: Independent slate-blue hue — no longer aliased to `tertiary` (that alias predates the v2.0.0 palette and no longer makes sense now that `tertiary` is the brand emerald accent).

Geist.role: headings, labels, buttons (LTR) — not yet bundled, falls back to system font

Inter.role: body copy (LTR) — not yet bundled, falls back to system font

Vazirmatn.role: all text (RTL/Persian) — bundled, the only typeface actually shipped

AZAR Icon Set.role: iconography, all contexts; zero-dependency pure-View composition, see design-system.md §6

phoneBreakpoints.$comment: AZAR ships on phones only (see design-system.md §13) — these are the required regression-test widths, not a separate column system. Every screen must render with zero horizontal overflow at all six.

iconButton.note: Every icon-only interactive control uses a 48dp x 48dp minimum interactive container regardless of the visual icon's own size; the icon itself is never enlarged to fill the container.

statCardGrid.note: KPI/stat rows are a FIXED 2-column percentage grid, never a minWidth-threshold flex-wrap — see design-system.md §13. A minWidth-based row (e.g. minWidth:140 + flex:1 in a flexWrap row) collapses to 1 column below ~390px content width and produces oversized near-empty cards; columnBasisPercent (47%, not 50%, to leave headroom for `gap` between the two columns — RN's `gap` adds to percentage widths rather than being subtracted from them) guarantees exactly 2 per row at every phone width in `phoneBreakpoints`, including the narrowest (320px). Card height is content-driven (no minHeight). v2.8.5: explicit literal 10px gap per direct user request (cards read as too small/cramped with the previous space-1(4) gap), paired with StatCard's internal padding bumped back up to space-3 and columnBasisPercent nudged back down 48%→47% to make room. v2.8.1 tightened gap from space-2(8) to space-1(4) and nudged columnBasisPercent 47%→48% to match — still read as too much air after the v2.7.2 pass.

emptyStateCompact.note: Used when an EmptyState is nested inside an existing page section (e.g. a dashboard sub-section) rather than filling the whole screen — the full space-8/icon-xl variant is reserved for screen-level empty states so a one-line 'nothing here yet' message doesn't dominate the page (see design-system.md §7.7/§15).
